question:
A diffraction-limited optical system has a circular aperture of diameter $D=2.0\,\text{cm}$. It is used to just resolve two distant point sources separated by an angular distance $\Delta\theta=3.0\times10^{-5}\,\text{rad}$.

Assume the Rayleigh criterion for a circular aperture and treat light as photons.

(i) Find the maximum wavelength $\lambda_{\max}$ for which the sources are just resolved.

(ii) Find the corresponding minimum photon energy $E_{\min}$ (in eV) and photon momentum $p_{\min}$ (in SI units). Use $hc=1240\,\text{eV}\cdot\text{nm}$ and $h=6.63\times10^{-34}\,\text{J\,s}$.
